name: ChatGPT
tagline: Conversational AI assistant for writing, coding, and research.
description: ChatGPT is a general-purpose conversational AI assistant that can answer questions, draft and edit text, explain concepts, write and debug code, and help with brainstorming and planning across almost any topic.

name: Claude
tagline: AI assistant for thoughtful writing, analysis, and coding.
description: Claude is a conversational AI assistant built for long-form writing, careful reasoning, document analysis, and software development, with an emphasis on helpful and reliable responses.

name: Midjourney
tagline: AI image generator known for painterly, high-quality art.
description: Midjourney generates highly stylized, artistic images from text prompts, popular with artists and designers for concept art, illustration, and creative exploration.

name: DALL·E
description: DALL·E generates and edits images from natural language descriptions, and can be used directly or through ChatGPT for quick visual concepts and illustrations.

name: Stable Diffusion
tagline: Open-source text-to-image model you can self-host.
description: Stable Diffusion is an open-source image generation model that can run locally or through many hosted tools, offering flexibility and fine-grained control over image generation.

name: Runway
tagline: AI video generation and editing suite.
description: Runway offers a suite of AI-powered video tools including text-to-video generation, video editing, motion tracking, and visual effects for creators and filmmakers.

name: Pika
description: Pika turns text prompts and still images into short video clips, with tools for style transfer, animation, and video editing.

name: ElevenLabs
tagline: Realistic AI voice generation and cloning.
description: ElevenLabs generates natural-sounding speech from text, supports voice cloning, and is widely used for narration, dubbing, and voiceovers.

name: Suno
tagline: Generate full songs from a text prompt.
description: Suno creates complete songs, including vocals and instrumentation, from a short text description of genre, mood, or lyrics.

name: GitHub Copilot
tagline: AI pair programmer built into your editor.
description: GitHub Copilot suggests code completions, whole functions, and tests directly inside your editor, trained to work across many languages and frameworks.

name: Cursor
tagline: AI-first code editor built on VS Code.
description: Cursor is a code editor with deep AI integration for chat-based editing, multi-file refactors, and code generation, built as a fork of VS Code.

name: Replit AI
tagline: AI coding assistant built into the Replit IDE.
description: Replit AI helps write, explain, and debug code directly inside the browser-based Replit development environment, and can scaffold full projects from a prompt.

name: Notion AI
tagline: AI writing and organization built into Notion.
description: Notion AI helps draft, summarize, and organize notes and documents directly inside Notion workspaces, including meeting notes and project docs.

name: Grammarly
tagline: AI writing assistant for grammar, tone, and clarity.
description: Grammarly checks grammar, spelling, tone, and clarity as you write, with suggestions for rewriting sentences across browsers, docs, and email.

name: Jasper
tagline: AI content generation for marketing teams.
description: Jasper generates marketing copy, blog posts, and social content, with brand voice controls aimed at content and marketing teams.

name: Perplexity
tagline: AI-powered answer engine with cited sources.
description: Perplexity answers questions in natural language and cites its sources, functioning as a research-focused alternative to traditional search engines.

name: Otter.ai
description: Otter.ai transcribes meetings in real time and generates summaries, action items, and searchable notes from audio and video calls.

name: Gamma
tagline: Generate presentations and documents with AI.
description: Gamma turns a text prompt or outline into a designed presentation, document, or webpage, handling layout and formatting automatically.
